look_here_first: Annual or biennial sneezeweed with winged stems and an unmistakably elongated ovoid-to-conical central disk surrounded by yellow rays.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Asteraceae/Helenium: composite heads with a raised receptacle, yellow or partly darkened rays, and often winged stems from decurrent leaf bases. Habit, stem wings, disk shape/color, and ray form are high-value characters.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: annual or biennial; stems with narrow wings; leaves variable from broad to grasslike; branched array of many heads; about 10–15 yellow rays; disk conspicuously ovoid to conical; disk often yellow below and yellow-brown toward tips; very numerous tiny disk florets

key_traits.label: Comparison training
key_traits.text: The name is literal: longdisk. The elongated cone-like disk is the fastest split from the more rounded heads of H. elegans and H. autumnale.
